recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current build-scope source already satisfies FHIR-32444; revisit only if a future work-group decision changes AuditEvent timing semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-32444 requested replacing AuditEvent.period with Provenance-style AuditEvent.occurred[x] and changing the datatype from Period to a choice of Period or dateTime for instantaneous events.
initial_application: Git commit 25018f7336cfa1cb370d0b8c1c8800df515cf1f9 explicitly applied FHIR-32444 by changing source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml from AuditEvent.period to AuditEvent.occurred[x] and adding dateTime alongside Period. Later commit 94c0e69169bfaae21f14ba9d6612fb251921cb6d updated the R4-R6 change map to AuditEvent.period=@AuditEvent.occurred[x].
additional_context: AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to the Security work group. Security WG Confluence minutes for 2021-09-13 list FHIR-32444 as Persuasive in the block vote and record Kathleen Connor / Luis Maas 8-0-1 approval. Local Zulip search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml defines AuditEvent.occurred[x] with max 1 and both Period and dateTime types, bundle-AuditEvent-search-params.xml searches occurred.ofType(dateTime) and occurred.ofType(Period), and the only remaining AuditEvent.period reference found is the R4-R6 rename mapping.
